Class UndoStack

java.lang.Object
be.imgn.swing.ui.UndoStack
@ViewScoped public final class UndoStack extends Object
The undo stack of a view, a bean of its scope, which the standard undo() and redo() commands act on. The text components bound with Form.bind(JTextComponent, Property) add their edits to it; other components add their own, such as a drawing that adds an edit per stroke. It is built on Swing's UndoManager, with its default limit of 100 edits. Every method is called on the EDT.
